name: Graveyard and reanimation
description: Fill your graveyard by milling and discarding, then bring your biggest creatures back. Black, green and blue cards with flashback spells, hefty creatures worth returning and ways to keep your graveyard safe.

cards.name: Ysolde, Keeper of the Turned Earth
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of your end step, mill two cards.
Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
{1}{B}{G}, Remove three +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavor_text: Nothing planted in her fields stays buried for long.

cards.name: Ithren, the Silted Lantern
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, mill two cards.
Whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Its lamp lights only the things that were lost.

cards.name: Barrow Gleaner
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, mill three cards. You may put a land card milled this way into your hand.

cards.name: Tidewrack Diviner
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, mill two cards, then draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: She reads the future in what the tide leaves behind.

cards.name: Turn Over the Old Soil
cards.rule_text:
Mill four cards. You may put a land card milled this way onto the battlefield tapped.
Flashback {4}{G}
cards.flavor_text: Every season leaves something in the ground.

cards.name: Murkwater Visions
cards.rule_text:
Draw two cards, then discard two cards.
Flashback {3}{U}

cards.name: Silt-Rise Rite
cards.rule_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. You lose 3 life.
cards.flavor_text: The river gives back what it was given.

cards.name: Ossuary Behemoth
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control.

cards.name: Loamheart Colossus
cards.rule_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard.
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Boneheap Gorger
cards.rule_text:
Menace
CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your graveyard.

cards.name: Grasp from the Barrow
cards.rule_text:
Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
Flashback {4}{B}

cards.name: Deepwater Refusal
cards.rule_text:
Counter target spell.
Flashback {5}{U}{U}
cards.flavor_text: The answer is no. It will still be no tomorrow.

cards.name: Crypt-Seal Lantern
cards.rule_text:
Cards in your graveyard can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.
{2}, {T}: Mill two cards.

cards.name: Tally of the Buried
cards.rule_text: Draw cards equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard, up to four. You lose 1 life for each card you drew this way.

cards.name: Duskmire Lamplighter
cards.rule_text:
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever you discard a creature card, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Mire-Bell Ringer
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When CARDNAME dies, mill two cards.
cards.flavor_text: One toll for the living. Two for everyone else.

cards.name: Drowned-Road Leviathan
cards.rule_text:
Ward {3}
When CARDNAME enters, return up to two target nonland permanents your opponents control to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Barrowfen Sinkhole
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
{T}: Add {B}, {G}, or {U}.
{3}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Ysmeth, Tender of Graves
cards.rule_text:
+1: Mill three cards. You gain 1 life for each creature card milled this way.
−2: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
−7: Return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. They gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Mourner's Reprieve
cards.rule_text:
Choose one or both —
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Cards in your graveyard can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control this turn.
